agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Comparison.right property was incorrectly returning self.tokens[-2] (a whitespace token) instead of self.tokens[-1] (the actual right-hand-side token of the comparison). Reverted to self.tokens[-1]. Verified via manual script that comparisons with keywords (NULL), floats, parenthesis expressions, strings, identifiers, and integers all now correctly expose the right-hand value instead of a blank space, matching the reported failure 'assert " " == "NULL"'. Temporary verification script removed; only sqlparse/sql.py was modified.
